name: pipeline-quote-fees
description: Single LONG round trip with FeeLeg.QUOTE: the fee is charged in QUOTE on BOTH sides (perps / cash-PnL convention). The buy fee is reserved out of the all-in cash at the SIZING layer (base / (1 + feeRate)), so cost*(1+rate) == funding with zero residual and no negative balance — reducing the fill at the execution layer would instead trip the partial-fill detector and cancel the entry. With funding 1000 @ price 100 the buy sizes 10/1.001 = 9.990009990 base (cost 999.000999 + 0.999000999 USDT fee = 1000). The yield is expressed against the entry COST basis (input = base*price = 999.000999, excluding the separately-tracked quote buy fee), with the buy fee folded into the realized output, so pnl (97.802198) and finalBalance (1097.802198) are exact — you turn 1000 into 1097.802198. The DISTINGUISHING signal vs RECEIVED is feesByAsset: QUOTE records BOTH fees in quote (2.097902 USDT) with NO base-asset entry (RECEIVED records 0.01 BTC on the buy).
